negative_reviews.author: Orsolya Jadoon
negative_reviews.text:
Found this restaurant on social media, looked cool, and good reviews about it, but for us the Worst experience ever. Just had been sent away from the restaurant because I’ve got Kfc chicken for my autistic daughter as she doesn’t eats that kind of food you  serve. Fairly gave details to the blonde haired women about our daughter’s autism and food sensitivity but she just ignored and still sent us out reasoned no other restaurant’s food is allowed inside. Also offered we can take our food outside the restaurant and eat else where… So embarrassing.
Well ur loss, not ours…we wanted to be a regular customer as we love Japanese foods. But definitely need to learn some acceptance as England is preaching all over about accept each other’s and hidden disabilities as well.

Do better people it’s very bad customer service, be open minded and educate urself if  u don’t know how to deal with different people. Not recommending.

negative_reviews.author: Chiara Latronico
negative_reviews.text: I’ve had a strange night at this restaurant. Ok, food is good, no complains about that. Curry, ramen, drinks they were not disappointing, BUT we had to move table 3 times due to the incredible noise and flash photography. Not sure if we ended up there on an influencers’ night but everybody, literally everybody was there to take pictures and have their pictures taken. No problem if it wasn’t for the fact that there was also a proper photographer with a real camera, with a very bright flash, that almost gave me a seizure. Despite me asking several time to not point the flash towards me the only solution was to move table, for a total of 3 times. The waiting time is also unpleasant. Takes time to order, even more to receive your order. If you receive the correct one, lots of mistakes were made to the tables around us. I might be back (the food is worth it), but I hope on a different night the atmosphere could be more relaxed and less hectic.

negative_reviews.author: たけむー
negative_reviews.text:
It was disappointing meal for me.
I visited around 3 pm when it’s not busy, I ordered a pint, fried chicken, ramen.
I received ramen first which was surprising, I expected to get appetizers first, and also ramen was not hot. 5mins passed since  I finished my ramen, I finally got chicken which is also not hot.
Very disappointed.

negative_reviews.author: Golden Kiwi
negative_reviews.text:
I was quite disappointed with this restaurant.
The food was pretty average, nothing special. The only edge it really gives is that it has a lot of halal options, without it the taste doesn’t really go far.

The atmosphere and decoration was pretty but it kind of gave off like they were trying to be tiktok viral with the bright neon aesthetics. The service was slow because most of the staff were filming tiktoks outside.

The only thing I liked was the sticky notes you can draw and put on their wall everywhere.

Worst of all was one male server who was very sassy and gave attitude to us. All we wanted was for each person to pay for each item they ordered for and he interrupted us saying guys we can’t do that, you just calculate the amounts to pay yourself and call me when you’re done. It was pretty annoying because no need to be rude and that is your job. Even weirder, later we could hear the staff telling other staff off because we were close to the staff area. It was pretty unprofessional.

Anyway I would not come again and do not recommend this place at all!!

negative_reviews.author: Xtina
negative_reviews.text: First off, they gave me a negitoro hand roll with GREY toro. I bit into it not realizing and it tasted off and old. I mentioned this and I was told that negitoro is this colour which is just a lie. The waiter was unorganized and chaotic. It seemed like it was everyone’s first day on the job. And the entry way is a bar filled with a million dishes. My biggest issue though was the poor food quality and the balls to lie to my face about the fish quality. The fish was GREY. not slightly off. It was pure grey so much so it made my sister almost throw up.

negative_reviews.author: Nia Iurilli
negative_reviews.text: I keep giving these handroll bars a shot and keep being disappointed. I got the full set of handrolls available and, don’t get me wrong I wasn’t expecting omakase standards but, for a place that is supposed to be better than your standard sushi round the corner, the level of food was remarkably below standards: the fish was so soaked in sauce you couldn’t tell what you were eating, the rice was falling apart, the avocado was incredibly hard. The midfatty tuna and the teriyaki salmon ones were decent, more of that please. Service was quite slow and kept forgetting items (woman next to me had to remind them 3 times). Atmosphere could definitely be better, there’s so much bright white light it seems you are going in for a surgery.

negative_reviews.author: Kunjira R.
negative_reviews.text:
The ingredients and freshness of the food were good for the price. However, there were some communication issues with the orders.

There were two of us dining, and we each ordered the 15-piece omakase set. The staff repeated the order correctly, but when the food arrived, only one set was served. I had to ask the staff about the second set, and that was when they realized only one order had been sent to the kitchen. As a result, my friend had to wait much longer for their omakase, even though we wanted to eat together.

We also ordered fresh plates, but they still had not arrived even after the omakase was served. We had to remind the staff before they started preparing it, so it seemed like the order had been missed.

Overall, it was still a good dining experience and the food quality was enjoyable, but the restaurant could improve its service flow and communication between staff and the kitchen, as the food service was quite slow and the ordering process seemed a bit disorganized.
